label: Backend JavaScript
summary: Backend modules call actions instead of AJAX routes
intro: Backend modules call actions through a small client. The client adds the bearer token of the logged-in user, so a session cookie alone is not sufficient.

label: HTTP API
summary: Scripts and apps send a token
intro: External applications call the same route with a token from EXT:hub. A declared error comes back with its status code.

snippets.code:
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
    https://example.org/typo3/api/my-extension/page/42/titles

# 200 OK
["Home", "Startseite", "Accueil"]

# 404 Not Found
{"error": "Page not found"}

label: OpenAPI
intro: The code shows an excerpt of the OpenAPI 3.1 document that TYPO3 generates at `/typo3/api/schema`. Swagger UI in the backend shows the same document.

snippets.code:
/my-extension/page/{uid}/titles:
  get:
    summary: Fetch the titles of a page
    security:
      - oauth2: ['content:read']
      - static: []
      - beuser: []
    parameters:
      - { name: uid, in: path, required: true, schema: { type: integer } }
    responses:
      '200':
        description: OK
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
      '404':
        description: if the page does not exist

label: MCP tool
summary: AI agents call the action as a tool
intro: The first code block shows the action in the MCP tool list (`tools/list`, shortened). The second code block shows a call from an AI agent.

label: Local MCP (stdio)
intro: Coding agents on a developer machine start TYPO3 as a local MCP server. The local MCP server needs no web server and no EXT:hub. The agent acts as the backend user that the command names.
